params.cache_reuse: jules-t18 drafted twice in a row (begin alone), then a third time in the product flow; jules-t16 after a cache reset without a prewarm, then after another reset with Drafter::prewarm waited for (up to 90 s)
params.engine: nugget_draft::Drafter (DraftConfig::default, local budget and temperature as below)
params.idle_prewarm: local-chat: finished before the warm-up draft
params.model: qwen3-1.7b-q8 (Qwen3-1.7B-Q8_0.gguf, local llama-server llama-server-linux-x86_64-cpu (b11940), thinking off)
params.prewarm: Drafter::prewarm with an app-only hint before begin, as apps/desktop doubletap/flow.rs (connection warm-up; retrieval starts in begin)
params.retrieval: nugget-retrieve text-only (no embedder), default RetrieveConfig, fixed reference time; one in-memory store per persona (draft fixture knowledge items + the persona's sent messages)
params.server_cpu: llama-server pid 19406: user + system CPU time from /proc/<pid>/stat
params.thinking_pass: 3 drafts, thinking at the model's default
params.timed_from: Drafter::begin (a11y read and IPC not included); from_trigger.* from the Drafter::prewarm call
params.voice: persona sent messages: recipient (>= 3 messages) or channel style statistics + 3 exemplars (recipient first, then most recent)
